## Review checklist

- [ ] The change has one clear purpose.
- [ ] I read the diff instead of accepting generated content blindly.
- [ ] Acceptance checks pass locally.
- [ ] Documentation and the project journal are current.
- [ ] A durable trade-off is captured in an ADR when needed.
- [ ] No secret, state file, credential, or private key is included.
- [ ] Rollback or recovery is understood.
